text:
sarah: Customer reporting intermittent 401s + high latency on embeddings endpoint. Happening ~10% of calls since yesterday. Sample request-id: 01GxyZ9a2b3c4d5e6f7g. Need minimal repro snippets (curl / py / js / go) and exact steps to collect a debug bundle and headers.

devon: Can you confirm region, SDK version, and whether this is on Hosted or Dedicated? Also best-effort timestamps for failures. :eyes:

sarah: Hosted, region us-west-2, SDK: python 0.9.1, node 1.2.4. Failures clustered between 2026-03-16 22:10 - 22:40 UTC.

lia: quick repro snippets below — keep them minimal and include the X-Request-ID header from the client when you re-run. Replace <API_KEY> and <REQ_ID>.

lia: curl (captures headers + timings):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: 01GxyZ9a2b3c4d5e6f7g" \
  -w "\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code} TIME_TOTAL:%{time_total}\n" \
  -D /tmp/resp_headers.txt \
  -o /tmp/resp_body.txt \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

lia: Python (requests minimal):
```
import os
import requests
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.getenv('RW_API_KEY')}", "X-Request-ID": "01GxyZ9a2b3c4d5e6f7g"}
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings', json={"input":"hello"}, headers=headers)
print(resp.status_code, resp.headers.get('X-Request-ID'), resp.elapsed.total_seconds())
print(resp.text[:1000])
```

lia: Node (fetch):
```
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
(async () => {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}`, 'X-Request-ID': '01GxyZ9a2b3c4d5e6f7g', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'hello' })
  });
  console.log(res.status, res.headers.get('x-request-id'));
  console.log(await res.text());
})();
```

lia: Go (net/http minimal):
```
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "os"
  "io/ioutil"
)
func main() {
  api := "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings"
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", api, bytes.NewBuffer([]byte(`{"input":"hello"}`)))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("RW_API_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("X-Request-ID", "01GxyZ9a2b3c4d5e6f7g")
  resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
  if err != nil { panic(err) }
  b, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println(resp.StatusCode, resp.Header.Get("X-Request-ID"))
  fmt.Println(string(b)[:1000])
}
```

support-bot: To collect a debug bundle, run the following on the machine that made the request and then upload the bundle to the ticket: `rw-support collect-debug --req-id 01GxyZ9a2b3c4d5e6f7g --out /tmp/rw-debug-01GxyZ.tar.gz`

lia: If not possible to run the bundle tool, at minimum gather:
- client logs around the timestamp (include full request/response headers)
- the output of the curl command above (resp_headers.txt and resp_body.txt)
- SDK debug logs (set env RW_SDK_DEBUG=1 for python/node/go and re-run)
- system time + traceroute if on a VM (optional)

oncall-bot: Please include the raw server response headers and the X-Request-ID in the ticket. Also provide one successful and one failed request pair so we can diff.

sarah: attaching two runs in the ticket now (one 200 and one 401). Example server header we saw on the 401: `X-Request-ID: 01GxyZ9a2b3c4d5e6f7g` `X-RW-Edge: edge-3` `Server-Timing: app;dur=502` and body: `{"error":{"message":"invalid credentials","code":401}}`.

devon: thanks — lia, can you run quick check for SDK 0.9.1 to ensure we aren't accidentally dropping Authorization header when retrying? Also check batching layer for embeddings.

lia: on it. I'll try to repro locally with the exact request id and SDK debug enabled. If we can't repro, next ask customer to run the curl snippet with `-D -` and the RW SDK debug env.

sarah: noted — I'll follow up with customer to run the curl/python snippets and upload the /tmp/rw-debug-01GxyZ.tar.gz bundle to the ticket. :thumbsup:
